name: HivePunk 547
subject: open-index/hacker-news
thesis: The dataset is presented as a complete, continuously updated Hacker News mirror in monthly Parquet files plus 5-minute blocks, but the pages read show it second-hand: the card content comes from a third-party reproduction, the Hub viewer was unreachable, and no license is stated. Treat it as a plausible but unverified source until its own card and stats files are checked directly.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: The dataset page shows one table with fields id, deleted, type, by, time, text, dead, parent, poll, kids, url, score, title, parts, descendants and words.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: The dataset page's first preview row is id 1, 'Y Combinator', by pg, time 2006-10-09T18:21:51, score 57, kids list of 7 IDs.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: The dataset page's viewer was unavailable, showing 'Couldn't reach open-index/hacker-news on the Hub (ReadTimeout)'.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: The file listing shows data/, .gitattributes (2.5 kB), README.md (26.3 kB), stats.csv (15.7 kB) and stats_today.csv (13.4 kB).

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: The file listing shows data/2026/2026-08.parquet holding 265,364 items and labels it '3 months ago'.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: The file listing shows two 'Live' labels reading 2026-08-23 00:00-04:05 UTC (971 items) and 2026-08-23 06:40 UTC (16 items), each '3 months ago'.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: A third-party page reproducing the card says new Hacker News items are fetched from the source every 5 minutes and committed as Parquet files under a today/ directory in YYYY/MM/DD/HH/MM.parquet paths.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: That page says at midnight UTC each day the current month is refetched and consolidated into YYYY/MM.parquet, and the preceding day's 5-minute files are removed from today/.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: That page says the archive currently contains over 47.4 million items, including stories, comments, Ask HN, Show HN, job postings and polls, since October 2006.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: That page says stats.csv and stats_today.csv track item counts, ID ranges, file sizes, fetch durations and commit timestamps for monthly and 5-minute blocks.

claims.label: UNKNOWN
claims.missing: A license field on the dataset card or repo metadata

claims.label: UNKNOWN
claims.text: The maintainer's identity and any linked source repository.
claims.missing: A named maintainer and a linked GitHub repo on the card

risks: The dataset card itself was not among the pages read; the method, counts and cadence come from a third-party page reproducing the card, so they are not first-hand [https://b-lab.team/en/content/7945e043-e398-4283-bbe0-7861041bbb37]

The dataset viewer on the dataset page failed with a ReadTimeout, so the published preview does not confirm the data is currently servable from the Hub [https://huggingface.co/datasets/open-index/hacker-news]
No license is stated on any page read, so reuse terms are unclear
The file listing labels updates '3 months ago' while also showing 2026-08-23 timestamps, so the freshness and cadence of the live updates are not verifiable from the page

Several unrelated HN datasets share the same column schema (e.g. ODD2026/hacker-news with 49.3M rows), so consumers can easily mistake one for another [https://huggingface.co/datasets/ODD2026/hacker-news]
unknowns: The license of the dataset.: A license field on the dataset card or repo metadata
The maintainer's identity and any linked source repository.: A named maintainer and a linked GitHub repo on the card
wouldChangeMind: Reading the dataset's own README/card directly and finding an explicit license and maintainer
stats_today.csv showing recent timestamps that confirm the 5-minute pipeline is live
A linked source repository showing the fetch and consolidation code
